test_case.test_name: NVIDIA WAT 250 DC cycles with HMC/BMC i2cPoll
test_case.purpose: Verify every approved management-bus device returns with expected response after each of 250 DC reboot cycles while OS/BMC health recovers.
test_case.test_command: After package, mapping and user approval, run the exact approved `wat_runner.py` 250-cycle DC/i2cPoll scenario with secure BMC endpoint and record DC states, OS/BMC readiness and complete HMC/BMC I2C inventory every cycle.
test_case.expected_result: All 250 cycles complete the signed DC transition/readiness and every expected controller-bus-address device responds without disallowed event or inventory loss.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires 250 per-cycle management-bus comparisons; host Linux I2C, final inventory only, silent retry or fewer cycles cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT/rated DC controller and explicit confirmation
Preserve logs; abort on device loss, boot loop, timeout, electrical/thermal fault
test_case.recovery: Fail fast, preserve the failed cycle, stop the controller safely, restore nominal DC/services, compare final bus inventory and use owner recovery without retry.
